items.h: Trump-Linked World Liberty Gets Conditional Bank Charter for USD1 Stablecoin
items.s: The proposed World Liberty Trust Company would take over issuance of the USD1 stablecoin from BitGo.

items.h: Bitcoin could bottom in October, altcoins are ‘basically dead,’ Swan CEO says
items.s: Klippsten said Bitcoin could bottom about a year after its previous peak and argued that crypto’s best outcome is to become part of TradFi.

items.h: Kalshi ordered to stop broad range of prediction markets in Washington
items.s: Kalshi must implement initial geofencing by Aug. 19 and a GeoComply multi-source geofencing system by Sept. 2.

items.h: Bitcoin's Drawdown Came Without a Liquidation Flush
Galaxy lowers CLARITY Act odds to 10%
items.s: Galaxy cited unresolved ethics, stablecoin yield and developer protection issues, along with a narrow Senate window when lawmakers return in September.
